# 测量仪表与数据质量

_Instrumentation & Data Quality_

温度、压力、转速、流量和振动等测量，是理解发动机运行与模型验证的基础。资料整理应同时记录测量位置、采样处理和误差来源。

_Temperature, pressure, speed, flow and vibration measurements support engine interpretation and model validation. Retain measurement positions, sampling and processing methods, and sources of uncertainty._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分传感器的测量量与经过计算、修正得到的性能量。

_Distinguish quantities sensed directly from performance quantities calculated or corrected afterward._

- 把量程、校准、采样频率、时间同步等信息与数据放在一起。

_Store ranges, calibration, sampling rates and time synchronisation information with the data._

- 对比不同试验时先核对定义与处理方法，再比较数值。

_Check definitions and processing methods before comparing values from different tests._
